$description: Material Glass design tokens. Material 3 color roles and scales, rendered on Liquid-Glass-style translucent surfaces. Unofficial; not affiliated with Google or Apple.

prism.$description: Light-first indigo and coral theme. Seed #4355B2.

obsidian.$description: Near-black and amber. Cool grey glass, strong specular. For dashboards and dev tools.

$source.description: Near-black and amber. Cool grey glass, strong specular. For dashboards and dev tools.

frost.$description: Light-first cobalt and lilac. High blur, low tint. For productivity apps.

$source.description: Light-first cobalt and lilac. High blur, low tint. For productivity apps.

ember.$description: Warm coral and gold on charcoal, with a sage accent. For media and food apps.

$source.description: Warm coral and gold on charcoal, with a sage accent. For media and food apps.

aurora.$description: Mint, violet and magenta. Gradient-forward and saturated. For landing pages and portfolios.

$source.description: Mint, violet and magenta. Gradient-forward and saturated. For landing pages and portfolios.

mono.$description: Achromatic greyscale. Proves the system works with no hue. The safe enterprise theme.

$source.description: Achromatic greyscale. Proves the system works with no hue. The safe enterprise theme.

sand.$description: Paper-toned neutrals, terracotta, olive and denim. Low blur, high opacity, closest to classic Material. For reading apps.

$source.description: Paper-toned neutrals, terracotta, olive and denim. Low blur, high opacity, closest to classic Material. For reading apps.

glass-tier.$description: Glass tiers replace the five Material surface-container levels. Higher tier = more blur, more opacity, brighter edge.

glass-presets.$description: Named glass materials. Set data-mg-glass on <html> or any container. Values override the theme's glass for that mode. text-safe presets are contrast-checked like themes; the others are for decoration and large display text only.

frosted.$description: The default: what the theme defines.

milk.$description: Thick, bright glass. Most legible translucent option.

smoked.$description: Darkened glass, like a tinted window.

crystal.$description: Thin, clear glass with a prismatic rim.

clear.$description: Barely there. Decorative surfaces and large display text only.

paper.$description: Opaque Material surfaces with a glass rim. No blur.
